title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

## Features
- npc/hotkey can start sex, cuddle, punishment scenes
- ability add scene descriptions
- mini-sexgame
- Injury Engine support
- May ask/order/punish actor
- DOM support

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- MageLight UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)

changelog:
### Intent pulldown
- New Intent pulldown in Animation Selection, Scene Creator and Description Editor: sexual, kissing, cuddle, vaginal / anal / oral, prepare, clean, custom
- Each listed animation keeps its intent as a badge; one animation can be listed more than once
- The HUD shows the intent ("vaginal sex", "preparing pussy")

### Clean and Prepare
- New actions Clean cock / pussy: an NPC cleans someone with their mouth, no enjoyment or orgasm
- New actions Prepare cock / pussy: oral foreplay that leads to vaginal or anal
- Clean Cum now means wiping with a cloth or hand

### Last stage
- The list fits the cast: solo, couple (cuddle, vaginal, oral, anal, clean) or group
- After an orgasm limit the NPC may only pick End scene, Cuddle or Clean
- In a scene you're in or control, the list never picks for you

### Animation filter
- The gender pulldown is now a button: match gender or positions, plus must / must not orgasm per actor
- Futa animations only when the cast has a futa

### Scene Creator and Description Editor
- New C column makes an animation current
- Fixed: a Scene Creator chain could start on a random entry

### Mini-game strategies
- Renamed to arouse / deny all, self, others or {name}. Tease is gone; old defaults still work

### Stages
- Skipped stages each play about 4 s
- In a scene you're in or control, stages are never forced forward
- Scenes where nobody orgasms (cuddle) advance on a timer

### Victim scenes
- Fixed: with endings off, a victim scene looped stage 3 → 1
- A lone victim now stops when told to

### Locked actors
- Scene Creator and Control Panel show locked actors with a 🔒; unlocking ends their SexLab or OStim scene and clears a stale OStim flag

### Bug Fixes
- No "failed to orgasm" for a scene SexLab ended before it started
- "prepare / clean her pussy" had the licking actor reversed
